versions.changelog:
- Improved Pinterest pin主图抓取指引，优化代理与浏览器环境说明，避免抓图出错。
- 更新了 Pinterest 抓图推荐方法说明，更清晰地区分不同机型代理设置与环境处理。
- 强调不要照搬代理配置，帮助用户按本机网络环境调整浏览器代理问题。
- 未涉及功能调整，仅文档引导细节更新。

- Added support for direct input of Pinterest links: automatically fetches and validates reference images from pins to generate lookbook photos.
- Generates 6 unified-style marketing images (outfit, flat lay, detail, lifestyle, couple, brand story) from one clothing photo or Pinterest link.
- Ensures a consistent, photorealistic, film-inspired aesthetic with specific prompts and negative cues to avoid artificial "AI look".
- All generated content follows popular Xiaohongshu/Pinterest visual content structures for higher engagement.
- Detailed workflow and prompt templates provided for accurate single-item extraction, scene selection, and style control.
